headline: Approved changes to the Senior Work off Policy; signed LA 4 and LA 13 state reports and a motor vehicle commitment.

plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – September 29, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of September 22, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Board did a final review of the Senior Work off Policy – the changes were unanimously voted in favor of
The Assistant will make the changes and forward to the Town Manager to review before going before
the Policy goes before the Select Board
The Chairman printed off a report to review Unknown Owners
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
The Board signed the preliminary LA 4 and LA 13 reports to be filed with the State (LA Local Assessment
LA – 4 Assessor’s Classification Report and LA 13 Growth Report)
The Board signed the Motor Vehicle Commitment 26-05
4. Adjourned Open Session @ 5:30 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:30 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
